lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs posterior to the gill slits are arranged in approximately four discernible vertical columns. Pixel intensity for these clusters is highest in the mid-lateral region, with blob diameter increasing slightly toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting with the primary white blobs, most prominent in the mid-flank region, creating a discernible grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral), extending from the supra-branchial region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin displays a dense cluster of small, high-luminance blobs, distinct from the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the primary flank.
